description: AM4.5 includes interactive tropospheric and stratospheric gas-phase and aerosol chemistry including ozone after Horowitz et al., 2020. The model includes 48 photolysis reactions, 254 gas-phase and heterogeneous reactions, and 91 advected chemical tracers. Updates (Paulot et al. (in preparation)) include: MeSH emission and chemistry (Wohl et al. (2024)), HPMTF chemistry for DMS, uptake of HNO3 and SO2 on dust (Paulot et al., 2016). Land deposition for gases and aerosols is calculated by the land component following Paulot et al. (2018).  The representation of aerosols in AM4.5 is through a bulk aerosol scheme including the 18 transported aerosol tracers from AM4.1 (Horowitz et al., 2020; 5 dust and sea salt, 3 organic aerosol, and 2 black carbon size classes plus SO4, NH4, and NO3) plus an additional 10 tracers for SO4 and NO3 on dust and other updates from Paulot et al. (in preparation): Improved land/chemistry coupling with interactive Fire-based chemical emissions and injection height based on fire radiative power after Pouyeai et al. (submitted), deposition of aerosols on snow to darken albedo, seasalt aerosol emission scheme and hygroscopicity are updated to Gong et al. (2003) and Ziegler et al. (2017).  Dust emission factors retuned to account for changes in the representation of wet and dry deposition. Marine organic aerosol (MOA) emissions are calculated following Gantt et al. (2015).
